jump five times.description: Presses spacebar 5 times for repeated jumps.

show desktop.description: Minimises every window to show the desktop.

close tab.description: Closes the current browser tab; Reopen tab can restore it.

go back.description: Goes back one page in the browser.

go forward.description: Goes forward one page in the browser.

press tab.description: Moves focus to the next field.

next field.description: Moves focus to the next field.

previous field.description: Moves focus to the previous field.

back field.description: Moves focus to the previous field.

back tab.description: Moves focus to the previous field.

other window.description: Switches to the previously active window.

period.description: Types a full stop at the cursor.

full stop.description: Types a full stop at the cursor.

comma.description: Types a comma at the cursor.

question mark.description: Types a question mark at the cursor.

exclamation mark.description: Types an exclamation mark at the cursor.

exclamation point.description: Types an exclamation mark at the cursor.

colon.description: Types a colon at the cursor.

semicolon.description: Types a semicolon at the cursor.

apostrophe.description: Types an apostrophe at the cursor.

quote.description: Types a double quotation mark at the cursor.

open quote.description: Types an opening quotation mark at the cursor.

close quote.description: Types a closing quotation mark at the cursor.

open parenthesis.description: Types an opening bracket at the cursor.

close parenthesis.description: Types a closing bracket at the cursor.

open bracket.description: Types an opening square bracket at the cursor.

close bracket.description: Types a closing square bracket at the cursor.

hyphen.description: Types a hyphen at the cursor.

dash.description: Types a dash with a space either side.

ellipsis.description: Types three dots at the cursor.

new line.description: Starts a new line, without a blank line between.

new paragraph.description: Starts a new paragraph, with a blank line between.

space.description: Types a single space at the cursor.

open notepad.description: Opens Notepad with a blank document.

open file explorer.description: Opens a new File Explorer window.

page zoom in.description: Makes the current browser page larger.

page zoom out.description: Makes the current browser page smaller.

open claude.description: Opens Claude in browser (desktop app not installed).

claude new chat.description: Starts a new Claude chat in browser.

new note.description: Creates a new note in Obsidian.

obsidian new note.description: Creates a new note in Obsidian.

quick switcher.description: Opens Obsidian's quick switcher to jump to a note by name.

open note.description: Opens Obsidian's quick switcher to jump to a note by name.

obsidian search.description: Searches every note in your Obsidian vault.

search all notes.description: Searches every note in your Obsidian vault.

search this note.description: Searches inside the Obsidian note you are in.

replace in note.description: Opens search and replace in the Obsidian note you are in.

graph view.description: Opens Obsidian's graph view of how your notes link together.

open graph.description: Opens Obsidian's graph view of how your notes link together.

toggle preview.description: Switches Obsidian between editing a note and reading it.

reading mode.description: Switches Obsidian between editing a note and reading it.

insert link.description: Inserts a link at the cursor in Obsidian.

follow link.description: Follows the Obsidian link under the cursor.

navigate back.description: Goes back to the note you were reading before in Obsidian.

navigate forward.description: Goes forward again through the Obsidian notes you have visited.

highlight text.description: Highlights the selected text in Obsidian.

today's note.description: Opens today's daily note in Obsidian, if the Daily Notes plugin is on.

daily note.description: Opens today's daily note in Obsidian.

toggle left sidebar.description: Shows or hides Obsidian's left sidebar.

indent line.description: Indents the current line in Obsidian.

unindent line.description: Unindents the current line in Obsidian.

open vs code.description: Opens the VS Code download page, because VS Code is not installed here.

open device manager.description: Opens Device Manager, where Windows lists your hardware.

open event viewer.description: Opens Event Viewer, the Windows system log.

open disk management.description: Opens Disk Management, where Windows lists your drives and partitions.

open sound settings.description: Opens the Windows sound settings, for input and output devices.

open display settings.description: Opens the Windows display settings, for resolution and scaling.

address bar.description: Puts the cursor in the browser's address bar.

bookmark this.description: Bookmarks the page you are on.

duplicate tab.description: Opens a second copy of the browser tab you are on.

mute tab.description: Mutes the sound coming from the Chrome tab you are on.

pin tab.description: Pins the Edge tab you are on so it stays at the front of the bar.

hard refresh.description: Reloads the page and ignores anything the browser had cached.

tab nine.description: Switches to the last browser tab.

report a bug.description: Opens the structured Samsara problem report form.

send feedback.description: Opens the Samsara beta feedback form.

open github.description: Opens github.com in your default browser.

open hugging face.description: Opens huggingface.co in your default browser.

delete next word.description: Deletes the word to the right of the cursor.

record screen.description: Starts or stops the Xbox Game Bar screen recording.

capture this window.description: Copies a picture of the focused window to the clipboard.

rename file.description: Renames the file you have selected.

permanent delete.description: Deletes the selected file outright, without sending it to the recycle bin.

go up folder.description: Moves up one folder in File Explorer.

read this.description: Has Windows Magnifier start reading aloud from the cursor.

read next sentence.description: Has Windows Magnifier read the next sentence aloud.

read previous sentence.description: Has Windows Magnifier read the previous sentence aloud.

start narrator.description: Starts or stop Windows Narrator (screen reader).

live captions.description: Toggles live captions (transcribes any audio on screen).

mono audio.description: Opens audio accessibility settings (mono audio, visual alerts).

sticky keys.description: Opens sticky keys settings (press modifier keys one at a time).

mouse keys.description: Opens mouse keys settings (control mouse with numpad).

pointer settings.description: Opens mouse pointer size and color settings.

eye control.description: Opens eye control settings (requires compatible eye tracker).

text cursor settings.description: Opens text cursor settings (thickness, color indicator).

immersive reader.description: Toggles immersive reader in Edge (clean reading mode).

read aloud.description: Starts Read Aloud in Edge browser.

open nvda.description: Opens NVDA screen reader (free, must be installed).

open jaws.description: Opens the JAWS product page, because JAWS is not installed here.

night light.description: Opens night light settings (reduce blue light).

make text bigger.description: Opens text size / visual accessibility settings.

cancel.description: Stops the recording Samsara is taking and throws it away.

bigger text.description: Makes the text bigger in the app you are using.

smaller text.description: Makes the text smaller in the app you are using.

show commands.description: Puts the command reference overlay on the screen.

hide commands.description: Takes the command reference overlay off the screen.

move to right monitor.description: Moves active window one monitor to the right.

move to left monitor.description: Moves active window one monitor to the left.

move to next monitor.description: Moves active window one monitor to the right.

send to far right.description: Moves active window to the far-right monitor (2 steps right).

send to far left.description: Moves active window to the far-left monitor (2 steps left).

send to middle monitor.description: Moves the focused window to the middle screen.

send to main monitor.description: Moves active window to the main (far-left) monitor.

restore window.description: Un-maximises the focused window so it can be moved.

send maximized right.description: Moves the focused window to the screen on the right, still maximised.

send maximized left.description: Moves the focused window to the screen on the left, still maximised.

remove file.description: Removes a file (preferred over 'delete file' to avoid collision with 'delete line').

open log.description: Opens the Samsara log file in Notepad.

scratch everything.description: Throws away the whole hands-free draft, asking you first.

transcribe file.description: Opens the window for transcribing an audio file you already have.
